reasons.claim: One chain from the father to Ibn Sinan, the brother written as the name alone.
reasons.quote: عن إبراهيم بن مهزيار عن أخيه علي، عن الحسين

reasons.claim: The Imam is named only in Ibn Sinan's words after the chain, so he is the last link as imam_in_text.
reasons.quote: قلت لأبي عبد الله عليه السلام

reviews.question: a fully written chain after the text ending «مثله» / «نحوه» (working rule 11)

reasons.claim: The first chain runs from Ubaydullah through his father and Shu'ba to Ibn Abbas.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبي، حدثنا شعبة، عن عدي، عن سعيد، بن جبير عن ابن عباس

reasons.claim: After the text two further routes, one through Ibn Idris and one through Ghundar with two co-transmitters, meet at Shu'ba and reuse the isnad; under working rule 11 they are routes of this saying.
reasons.quote: جميعا عن غندر، كلاهما عن شعبة، بهذا الإسناد نحوه

reasons.claim: A single chain ending at Abu Hurayra, with the unnamed father as a relation link and the Prophet ending the chain.
reasons.quote: عن سهيل، عن أبيه، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي

reasons.claim: The chain runs to al-Bahrani, then marks an unnamed gap before the Imam, who is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن محمد بن سهل البحراني (2)، رفعه إلى أبي عبد الله الصادق جعفر بن محمد

reasons.claim: Al-Faqih's «و روى X عن Y» opens a chain of two transmitters ending at the Imam who speaks.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى عَبْدُ اَللَّهِ بْنُ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: After Ubaydullah an unnamed transmitter stands before the Imam, who is the last link; the Prophet ends the chain.
reasons.quote: عن عبيد الله بن عبد الله، عمن سمع أبا جعفر الباقر

reasons.claim: The text writes only one route before «ح», ending at Abu Sa'id.
reasons.quote: سمع عبد الله، بن أبي عتبة يحدث عن أبي سعيد الخدري، ح

reasons.claim: Three «ح» branches, the second with two co-transmitters, all meet at al-Zuhri and reuse the earlier isnad.
reasons.quote: كلهم عن الزهري، بهذا الإسناد نحوه

reviews.question: a first-person narrative with an unnamed speaker or implicit transmission (the story's end is told in the first person by the one sent out)

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters at the first level and four at the second, joined by «جميعا», meet at al-Barqi, giving eight routes.
reasons.quote: وَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ جَمِيعاً قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَرْقِيُّ

reasons.claim: The chain ends at the Imam who relates the story; the readings stand if the unruled question goes that way, but would gain a link if the first-person teller were counted.

reviews.uncertainty_note: The first-person close could imply an implicit transmitter after the Imam, which the owner has not ruled on.

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters reach the Imam, who continues the route through his father, grandfather and forefathers.
reasons.quote: عن أبي بصير، ومحمد ابن مسلم، عن أبي عبد الله

reasons.claim: Amir al-Mu'minin is named in the words after the chain, so he is the last link as imam_in_text.
reasons.quote: عن آبائه عليهم السلام أن أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام قال
